# Qt 6.12.0 Qt Core, GUI, and Network third-party attribution index

Source: [Qt 6.12 Third-Party Code Used in Qt](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6.12/licenses-used-in-qt.html), checked 2026-10-11. Each linked local page is the official Qt attribution page for the component. The Qt 6.12 index describes module source; it does not establish that a particular component is present in the PatchTrace Windows package. Use the final PyInstaller/DLL inventory to select applicable notices.
